map.逐项判定：无损检测合格率≥99%、水压保压时间≥30min、气密性泄漏率≤0.0: Item-by-item check: NDT pass rate ≥ 99%, hydrostatic hold time ≥ 30 min, tightness leak rate ≤ 0.01%; all three must be met for acceptance. Low pass rate hides defects, short hold misses leaks, high leak rate is dangerous.

map.气密泄漏率 0.01% 严吗？: Is the 0.01% tightness leak rate strict?
